components.name: Tuner (RTL-FM Process Manager)
components.description: Manages rtl_fm subprocess lifecycle — start/stop/retune, reads raw PCM from stdout, distributes to audio and whisper queues

components.name: Stream Source (Web Stream Ingest)
components.description: Pulls live audio from public internet streams (LiveATC, NOAA) via ffmpeg subprocess, converts to 16kHz mono PCM for the pipeline

components.name: Input Source Abstraction
components.description: Unified interface wrapping Tuner (SDR) and StreamSource (web stream) behind a common PCM queue — downstream components are source-agnostic

components.name: Transcriber (Hailo Whisper)
components.description: Reads PCM from whisper queue, accumulates 10-second chunks (160k samples), runs silence detection, performs Whisper inference on Hailo-8L NPU via encoder/decoder HEF pipeline with repetition penalty, or faster-whisper CPU fallback
components.notes: Hailo inference implemented 2026-02-24. Uses VDevice/InferModel API with whisper-tiny encoder (10s) + decoder (32 tokens). mel.py provides log-mel spectrogram. Models downloaded via scripts/download_models.sh.

components.name: Audio Router (HTTP Streaming)
components.description: Reads PCM from audio queue, wraps in streaming WAV headers, serves as chunked HTTP response for browser audio playback

components.name: Flask Application (Backend API)
components.description: Flask + Flask-SocketIO server — REST API routes for tuning/control, WebSocket events for real-time transcript/status/signal delivery, thread orchestration

components.name: Frontend (Console UI)
components.description: Single-page web interface — preset selector, signal meter, audio player, transcript feed, squelch/gain controls. Vanilla JS + Web Audio API + Socket.IO client

components.name: Frequency Presets
components.description: Preset definitions for SDR frequencies and web stream URLs — weather, aviation, marine, public safety, broadcast categories for the Redmond/Seattle area

components.name: Mel Spectrogram Utility
components.description: Log-mel spectrogram computation for Hailo Whisper encoder input. 80 mel bins, STFT n_fft=400, hop=160, 10s chunks (1000 frames). Uses pre-computed mel_filters.npz.

components.name: NOAA Weather Parser
components.description: Structured parser for NWS weather radio broadcasts — extracts temperature, wind, humidity, visibility, marine forecasts, and priority alerts (warnings/watches) from Whisper transcripts using regex patterns

components.name: APT Pass Scheduler
components.description: Satellite pass prediction for NOAA-15/19 using PyEphem orbital mechanics and Celestrak TLEs. 24h lookahead, 20° minimum elevation filter, background scheduling loop with 10-minute advance notification via Socket.IO

components.name: APT Image Decoder
components.description: Records NOAA APT satellite passes using rtl_fm (137 MHz wideband FM, 60k sample rate, 11025 Hz output) piped to sox for WAV conversion, then decodes with noaa-apt CLI to PNG. Manages image storage and history

components.name: WEFAX Broadcast Scheduler
components.description: Parses NMC Point Reyes and NOJ Kodiak broadcast schedules, selects optimal HF frequency based on time of day, triggers recording jobs at scheduled broadcast times with 5-minute advance notification

components.name: WEFAX Receiver & Decoder
components.description: Records HF WEFAX broadcasts using rtl_fm with Q-branch direct sampling (-D 2) and USB demodulation, decodes with fldigi via Xvfb headless. Structured PNG output with station/frequency/chart metadata

components.name: Meteor Scatter Detector
components.description: Forward scatter power monitor using rtl_fm on carrier frequency. Rolling 30s baseline, threshold-based burst detection, duration filtering (50ms-30s), underdense/overdense trail classification. Supports dual dongle mode for 24/7 monitoring

components.name: Meteor Statistics Analyzer
components.description: Shower calendar with 7 major annual showers, active shower correlation on detections, hourly/daily rate calculation, session statistics with peak rate and underdense/overdense ratio

components.name: UI Process (ui_app)
components.description: Flask + Socket.IO front half. Holds no hardware, so the console loads and stays responsive while the radio process is restarting or dead.
components.notes: Phase 18. Retiring the radio process's own Flask app is still outstanding.

components.name: IPC Framing (ipc)
components.description: Newline-delimited JSON framing shared by both sides of the UI/radio split.

components.name: IPC Server (ipc_server)
components.description: Radio-side command surface. Accepts tune/stop/status requests over the Unix socket and streams events back.

components.name: Radio Link (radio_link)
components.description: UI-side client for the radio process, with reconnect and a LINK UP/DOWN indicator surfaced in the console header.

components.name: SDR Arbiter (sdr_arbiter)
components.description: Single owner of the dongle. A queue-of-one that coalesces redundant tune requests and exposes commanded vs actual state as LOCKED / SWITCHING / FAULT, plus adopt() for whatever the hardware is already doing.
components.notes: The console header renders this directly — the transition is visible, not inferred.

components.name: Emit Bridge (emit_bridge)
components.description: Hands Socket.IO emits from real threads to a green thread. eventlet makes logging locks green, so a real thread touching them raises greenlet.error and dies.

components.name: Subprocess Decoder Base
components.description: Shared lifecycle for the external decoders: spawn, per-record TTL, stderr capture, and distinguishing a busy dongle from a missing binary.

components.name: ADS-B Receiver
components.description: dump1090 aircraft tracking feeding the shared map.

components.name: AIS Receiver
components.description: Marine vessel tracking plotted alongside aircraft.

components.name: APRS Receiver
components.description: AFSK1200 packet decode on 144.390 MHz — positions, weather and telemetry.

components.name: ACARS Receiver
components.description: VHF aircraft messaging via acarsdec, correlated against tracked ADS-B flights.

components.name: ISM Receiver (rtl_433)
components.description: 315/345/433/915 MHz sensor traffic — weather stations, TPMS, utility meters, door and window sensors — with every reported field surfaced.

components.name: Pager Receiver (POCSAG/FLEX)
components.description: rtl_fm piped into multimon-ng. Numeric payloads containing the unassigned BCD codes [ and ] are labelled undecodable rather than shown as messages.
components.notes: Counting digits does not detect a bad numeric decode — the noise is ~75% digits.

components.name: ADS-B Correlator
components.description: Matches spoken and ACARS callsigns against tracked flights.

components.name: Signal Classifier
components.description: MobileNetV2 over IQ spectrograms. Backend order is Hailo NPU, then trained ONNX on the CPU (~58 ms), then hand-written heuristics.
components.notes: Three of six classes are validated across frequencies; the rest are marked unproven in the UI because each was seen on only one.

components.name: SEI Model
components.description: Specific-emitter identification — a 1D CNN with attention fingerprinting transmitters from raw IQ.

components.name: IQ Collector
components.description: Captures raw IQ windows via rtl_sdr, gated on spectral peak-to-median so empty channels never enter the corpus.

components.name: IQ Collection Scheduler
components.description: Rotates the dongle across bands to build a labelled corpus, balanced by class rather than frequency, with dwell weighted toward under-represented classes.

components.name: IQ Segmenter
components.description: Splits the IQ stream into windows and decides which carry a transmission.

components.name: IQ Capture
components.description: Direct pyrtlsdr IQ path with FM/AM/WFM demodulation, squelch and de-emphasis; falls back to rtl_fm when pyrtlsdr is unavailable.

components.name: Observation Log
components.description: Durable emitter and decoder history — first/last seen and counts — surviving restarts.

components.name: Config
components.description: Persisted runtime settings: thresholds, keyword watchlist, last preset and startup behaviour.

components.name: Weather Accumulator
components.description: Votes across NOAA's broadcast loop to extract location, temperature, high/low, conditions and wind — robust to whisper-tiny garble no single chunk survives.

components.name: Learn Explainer (/learn)
components.description: Twelve-section animated walkthrough from radio wave to classification, with a stepped execution trace of real captured values and figures read live from the node. D3 is vendored for air-gapped operation.

components.name: UI Snapshot Harness
components.description: Renders the console and /learn in real Chromium at five viewport sizes, screenshots every view, and reports horizontal overflow, small text and small tap targets.
components.notes: Snapshots the served page and drives it over file:// — Chromium 150 on this Pi cannot commit an HTTP navigation.
